topic: Which magical discovery would you choose?

variants.label: THE CELESTIAL ATLAS
variants.brief: An antique star atlas spread open on a desk under the moonlit observatory dome.

variants.image_prompt: A large open celestial atlas with golden constellation diagrams is centered on an astronomer's desk in a moonlit observatory, a brass telescope behind it. Single vertical photorealistic image without text or collage.
